The node also asserts that the B_crys comparison of Theorem 14.5(i) agrees with Theorem 13.1, and that comparison is CP.2/rational-crystalline-comparison-over-C. Its acceptance list further requires compatibility with Fargues' pair for H^i_Ainf(X), an AI.5 object; AI.5 is not upstream of CP.3.
